news.title: New major risk - Revenue size
news.body: The company makes less than US$1m in revenue. Total revenue: ₹45m (US$495k) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small amount of revenue are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. Mr. khokan halder Rabari is Post graduate in M.Com. news.title: Pressure Sensitive Systems (India) Limited Appoints Bipinkumar Bharatbhai Patel as Additional Director (Non-Executive - Independent Director), Effective from January 16, 2026
news.body: Pressure Sensitive Systems (India) Limited appointed Mr. Bipinkumar Bharatbhai Patel as an Additional Director (Non-Executive - Independent Director) of the Company, effective January 16, 2026. Mr. Bipinkumar Bharatbhai Patel is a graduate in Commerce from Gujarat University college. The appointment was approved at the meeting of the Board of Directors held on January 16, 2026 at the registered office of the company. As per the affirmations of the Directors appointed as mentioned above, Mr. Bipinkumar Bharatbhai Patel is not debarred from holding the office of director by virtue of any SEBI order or any other such authority. Mr. Bipinkumar Bharatbhai Patel is not related to any director of the company.
